# Marchpoint Couriers - September loading scans

One row per loading scan captured by the depot handhelds; rows are
in capture order, not route order. parcel_id identifies the parcel,
and a parcel is scanned exactly once, at loading.

The first September export run hit a gateway timeout and rewrote a
stretch of the file: a few scans appear twice, byte-identical, under
the same scan_id. Row counts are therefore not parcel counts.
